pages.text: A $(item)Race Control$() is the start and finish line. Put down $(item)Race Flag$()s and right-click each to number it: a lap is every flag in order and back over the line.$(br2)$(l)Time trials$() are free. $(l)Races$() take an entry fee into a pot, and the winner takes it.
Racing: the clock, your lap, the next checkpoint and your place.
